content.short: Cardano Robots is a collectible art project created on Cardano Blockchain as NFT with total supply 2,590 unique.
content.description: Cardano Robots is a collectible art project. Each piece you can buy as NFT. Our art will be minted as a native token on Cardano blockchain. Cardano Robots features 2,590 unique pieces. We have 5 Editions. Largest Edition is Friends: These robots are friendly, have a lot of friends and a lot of activities. Smallest edition of Cardano Robot is Gold Edition: They are rich and influential robots that occur in small quantities. They are characterized by gold necklaces, a cigar, a crown and a bag full of cardano ​coins.
content.meta: Find out about Cardano Robots (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
